contivoAi.h1Post: — how artificial intelligence changes the work of an accounting firm
contivoAi.lead: AI accounting is an approach where artificial intelligence takes over the most repetitive part of accounting work: it reads documents, codes them and posts them, while a human approves and makes the decisions. Below we explain what an AI accounting program is, how it works and what it really changes in an accounting firm.

sections.title: What AI-based accounting is
sections.body: A traditional accounting program is a tool in which the accountant does everything manually. An accounting program with AI goes further: an artificial intelligence model understands the content of documents and proposes postings on its own, flags errors and answers regulatory questions. AI in accounting does not replace the accountant — it takes over routine and gives back time for knowledge work.

sections.title: How AI posts a document — step by step

points.d: AI reads an invoice or document from an email or scan — line items, amounts, the counterparty, tax ID.
The model proposes a posting to the right accounts, following the chart of accounts and the firm’s practice.
The document is matched to the right client and accounting period.
The accountant approves or corrects with one click — the rest happens automatically.

sections.title: What an accounting firm gains with AI

points.d: Repetitive postings and retyping data from invoices disappear.
The same team serves more companies because AI handles the routine.
AI catches unusual amounts, missing documents and upcoming deadlines.
The AI assistant knows the current legal state — VAT, PIT, CIT, KSeF, JPK.

sections.title: An accounting program with AI — this is what Contivo does
sections.body: Contivo is the first Polish accounting system designed from the ground up around artificial intelligence (AI-Native). AI reads and posts documents, the assistant answers regulatory questions, and the system tracks KSeF, JPK, ZUS and tax-return deadlines. All in one cloud platform — with code, hosting and data in Poland.

contivoAi.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about AI accounting

faq.q: Will artificial intelligence replace the accountant?
faq.a: No. AI takes over repetitive routine — reading and posting documents — while the accountant approves, decides and handles matters that require expertise. It is a tool that boosts productivity, not a replacement for a person.

faq.q: Is AI accounting safe?
faq.a: In Contivo, yes — code, hosting and data stay in Poland, and the system is GDPR-compliant. Documents are not sent abroad.

faq.q: Is an AI accounting program compliant with Polish regulations?
faq.a: Yes. Contivo natively supports KSeF, generates JPK_V7, JPK_KR and JPK_FA and handles ZUS, and the AI assistant knows the current legal state.

faq.q: How do I start with AI accounting?
faq.a: The easiest way is to try a ready system. Contivo supports taking over a company from your current program, including importing HR data and historical settlements.

homeSeo.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about working with Codentra

faq.q: What does Codentra do?
faq.a: Codentra is an AI software house based in Świdnica, Poland. We design and build custom software — web applications, SaaS platforms and internal tools — and implement AI-based solutions in businesses. We are the makers of Contivo, an AI accounting system for accounting firms.

faq.q: What is Contivo?
faq.a: Contivo is Codentra's own product — the first AI-native Polish accounting system for accounting firms, available at contivo.pl. AI reads and posts documents, and the system handles KSeF, JPK, ZUS DRA, HR and payroll and fixed assets in one cloud platform.

faq.q: Do you only work with companies in Poland?
faq.a: Our headquarters is in Świdnica, Poland, and we work with companies across the country. Most of our collaboration happens remotely, so location is rarely a constraint.

faq.q: How long does it take to build custom software?
faq.a: It depends on scope. We work iteratively: after discovery we deliver a working prototype of the product core within 2–3 weeks, then build out full functionality in short cycles with frequent releases.

faq.q: What does an AI implementation look like?
faq.a: We start by identifying processes where AI will have a measurable impact — such as document handling, answering customer questions or searching company knowledge. Then we build a prototype, measure answer quality and integrate the solution with your systems.

faq.q: Is company data safe during an AI implementation?
faq.a: Yes. We design GDPR-compliant solutions with control over where data is processed. We know Polish regulations — KSeF, JPK, ZUS — because we work with them every day in Contivo.

faq.q: Which technologies do you use?
faq.a: A modern web stack (including TypeScript, React and Next.js), cloud infrastructure with CI/CD, and large language models (LLMs) with techniques such as RAG, function calling and AI agents.
